orig.credit: Traditional Hebrew text (Hebrew Wikisource, the version set out by metre and rhyme; norefs drops the variant note "(ס"א לנו הישועה)" in stanza 6)

stanzas: Rock of Ages, let our song, praise Thy saving power;
Thou, amidst the raging foes, wast our sheltering tower.
Furious they assailed us, but Thine arm availed us,
And Thy Word broke their sword, when our own strength failed us.
Kindling new the holy lamps, priests, approved in suffering,
Purified the nation's shrine, brought to God their offering.
And His courts surrounding, hear, in joy abounding,
Happy throngs, singing songs with a mighty sounding.
Children of the martyr race, whether free or fettered,
Wake the echoes of the songs where ye may be scattered.
Yours the message cheering that the time is nearing
Which will see, all men free, tyrants disappearing.
en.credit: "Rock of Ages", free English rendering by Marcus Jastrow and Gustav Gottheil (19th century), as quoted in Wikipedia's article

stanzas: Ma'oz Tzur Yeshu'ati, lekha na'eh leshabe'ach.
Tikon beit tefilati, v'esham toda nezabe'ach.
Az egmor beshir mizmor chanukat hamizbe'ach.
Ra'ot save'ah nafshi, b'yagon kochi kala.
Chayai mereru be'koshi, b'shi'abud malkhut egla.
Cheil par'o v'khol zar'o yaredu ke'even bimtzula.
D'vir kodsho hevi'ani, ve'gam sham lo shakateti.
Uva noges ve'higlani, ki zarim avadti.
Ketz Bavel Z'rubavel, le'ketz shiv'im nosha'ati.
K'rot komat berosh bikesh, Agagi ben Hamdatah.
ve'niheyata lo le'fach ulemokesh, ve'ga'avato nishbata.
Rosh ye'mini niseta, ve'oyev shmo machita.
Rov banav ve'kinyanav al ha'etz talita.
Ye'vanim nikbetzu alai, azai bimei Chashmanim.
Ufartzu chomot migdalai, ve'tim'u kol hashmanim.
B'nei vina y'mei shmona kav'u shir ur'nanim.
Chasof z'ro'a kodshekha, ve'karev ketz hayeshu'a.
Ki arkha hasha'a, ve'ein ketz limei hara'a.
D'cheh admon betzel tzalmon, hakem lanu ro'im shiv'a.
